facts.text: Report holder BOXABL; subject is Boxabl structural insulated panels.
Used only in Boxabl Casitas, factory-built structures using the proprietary Boxabl connection system.
'Structural Insulated Panels have not been evaluated in fire-resistance-rated construction.'
Limited to buildings of Type V construction; wood-based materials protected from decay and termites per IBC §2304.12 and IRC §R317.
Shear walls in SDC C through F require special inspection; for SDC D through F, collectors, connections and anchorage use the ASCE/SEI 7 §12.4.3 special load combinations with Em.
Evidence listed: AC04 (June 2019); NFPA 286; ASTM E331 water penetration; ASTM E2126 cyclic racking.
